summary: Single-PR legacy adoption can deadlock when both occupied routine lanes lack admission metadata: each refuses the other unknown reservation. The separate --adopt-known-roster route binds exactly two native identities, branches/heads, campaigns/distinct chains, text preimages and observed PR base pointers, plus current main independently. It compares the complete paginated population with full detail preimages and branch refs, reuses normal capacity/chain policy over explicit assignments, and preserves unrelated machine markers/source. A requested initial delivery-continues declaration is generated explicitly; arbitrary machine-marker injection still refuses. Durable per-native-pair custody records possible-send before each PATCH and exact independent readback before proceeding. Any partial or uncertain result stops; every re-entry is read-only and refuses resend, even with an edited plan. REST PR-list responses omit merged and maintainer_can_modify, so population identity/text/head/base agreement is checked separately from full detail guards. A legacy PR native base pointer can precede current main without being rewritten or claimed up-to-date. GitHub supplies no PR-text compare-and-swap; adjacent guards are not server atomicity. Source and offline controls do not establish actual adoption, installed qualification or effect authority. Scope: known two-PR recovery under the ordinary cap2; the selected SC2 cap3 exception is unchanged.
title: Recover an explicit two-legacy-PR roster without unknown-reservation waivers
